ui.trade.emptyTitle: See what matters for your next upgrade

ui.trade.methodDescription: We keep the rest of your build fixed, test each affix on a reference item and your current item when available, and average its marginal contribution. Trade weights are the contribution per stat point. These are reference estimates, not gains from a complete replacement item; percentages cannot be added together. Budget changes update the search without recalculating weights.
ui.trade.unsupportedHint: Some mechanics are not supported; scores are estimates

support.title: Find support upgrades automatically
support.hint: Automatically checks skill compatibility, character level and gem families. Compares replacements, then explores support combinations.
support.capacityHint: Imports do not include unlocked socket counts. Defaults to occupied sockets, or two; adjust only to your actual capacity.
support.excluded: {total} excluded: compatibility unknown {unknown} · level too low {level} · incompatible {incompatible}
support.filterHint: Uncheck supports with downsides you want to avoid, or exclude them directly from a recommendation. Individual tiers are selected separately.
support.searchPlaceholder: Search by localized or English name
support.excludedHint: Saved for this skill in this browser. Changes only search candidates; your equipped gems and comparison baseline stay intact. Recalculate after editing.
support.allExcluded: All eligible supports are excluded. Restore at least one to calculate combinations.
support.removeOnly: All eligible supports are excluded. You can still calculate removing the equipped supports.
support.empty: No confirmed usable supports for this skill. Missing or unmodeled effects are not recommended.
support.noGain: No fully recalculated improvement found within the search budget and current constraints.
support.limit: All candidates receive individual probes. Combination search is bounded and is not a guaranteed global optimum. Only engine-reported limits are shown; absence of a diagnostic does not prove every support effect is modeled. Minion-specific compatibility remains limited; extra lineage-copy allowances are not modeled.
support.unsupported: Excluded combinations with newly unmodeled effects
support.adjustment: Ordinary support gems do not need a trade search
support.keepActive: Keeps the active gems, replaces the complete support set.
support.descriptionsHint: Descriptions from the pinned PoB2 source. These describe intended effects and tradeoffs, not level-specific values or which effects PoBR models.
support.descriptionUnavailable: No source description is available in this data snapshot.
support.catalogError: Support compatibility data could not be loaded. Reload to try again.
support.baselineLimitsHint: These are the verbatim limits reported for the evaluated baseline. A recommended gain does not resolve them; baseline and previews remain incomplete.
support.diagnosticExcludedHint: These complete evaluated sets introduced new calculation limits, failed in the engine or returned invalid statistics. They are not recommendations and cannot be applied. Manual filters and compatibility exclusions are separate.

guidance.title: Build references
guidance.hint: Find a related build, understand the differences, then verify an upgrade on your character.
guidance.noSkill: Select a skill to inspect for meaningful matches.
guidance.gapHint: Start with these gaps when comparing equipment. The target follows your upgrade settings.
guidance.skillHint: Compare the selected skill’s levels, quality and supports. Calculate compatible combinations before changing them.
guidance.gearHint: Compare complete items and socketing. A shared unique is a similarity signal, not proof that you need it.
guidance.treeHint: Review effects and trade-offs, then plan connected paths with travel and respec costs.
guidance.partial: Some effects or items are not calculated. Resolve the coverage gaps before trusting upgrade percentages.
guidance.leagueHint: Choose the same league as your character. Links search poe.ninja using the selected main skill and class.
guidance.history: Historical samples, not live ladder rankings. Source league, patch and date are shown on each build; results do not establish the current meta.
guidance.search: Filter by skill, class or unique
guidance.empty: No matching samples. Relax the filters or find a reference on poe.ninja and paste its PoB2 code below.
guidance.failed: Reference samples could not be loaded. You can still paste a reference code.
guidance.formula: Main skill 55; ascendancy 20 (or class 10); support overlap 15; unique overlap 10. Missing signals earn no points. This is not an upgrade percentage.
guidance.pasteHint: Copy a PoB2 export code from a poe.ninja character. This opens a comparison without replacing your build. Pasted references stay in this view only.
guidance.pasted: Pasted reference · league and date unverified
guidance.mainOnly: Selected main groups. Supports on a different main skill are not directly transferable.
guidance.differences: Different setups require coordinated changes. These differences are observations; the planners calculate candidate gains using your current build.
guidance.passiveVersion: Passive IDs are resolved against the installed game data. Historical names and effects may have changed; verify the source before planning a respec.
guidance.notesHint: Author text is reference material; it is not a verified upgrade recommendation.
guidance.notRelated: No shared main skill, class or unique found. Browse these as alternatives, not close matches.

nodePower.title: Node power report
nodePower.hint: Compare candidate passives and paths for the selected stat, ranked by gain per point.
nodePower.scope: Masteries and other weapon-set routes are unavailable. New unsupported effects are diagnosed instead of scored. These are route comparisons, not automatic allocations or a guarantee that your current point budget can afford every route.
nodePower.notStarted: Run an evaluation to see candidate rankings
nodePower.calculationHint: Gain/point uses the full connected route, including travel points. Single node uses the heat-map probe. Ascendancy routes spend ascendancy points. Each run evaluates up to 128 filtered nodes in cancellable batches; repeat to cover the remaining nodes.

jewelPlanner.title: Jewels and passive routes
jewelPlanner.hint: Paste a jewel and add the sockets to compare. Each plan combines one candidate placement with passive changes, using the goal, point budget and travel attributes above. Paths to empty sockets cost points.
jewelPlanner.empty: Add a jewel placement to compare it with keeping your current jewels.
jewelPlanner.limit: Up to 8 placements and 512 route evaluations per placement, plus current jewels. Search is bounded; the global optimum is not guaranteed.
jewelPlanner.exclusive: Joint jewel planning requires a shared tree without weapon-set-only passives.
jewelPlanner.bounded: Search was limited; only evaluated routes are covered.

jewelPlanner.stale: The build changed. Run the search again.
jewelPlanner.skipped: Plans with new unmodeled effects skipped
jewelPlanner.noSockets: No socket within the point budget

treeOptimizer.title: Plan passive upgrades
treeOptimizer.hint: Find the {points} most valuable passives for your goal.
treeOptimizer.scope: Plans change the shared main tree. Ascendancy, mastery choices, weapon-set-only nodes and the value of an empty jewel socket are excluded. Attribute travel points use the choice above.
treeOptimizer.refundUnavailable: Automatic refunds are unavailable with weapon-set passives, mastery or unknown nodes, or when the imported tree cannot be fully connected to the class start.
treeOptimizer.noResults: No improving legal plan was found within this budget and search range.
treeOptimizer.bounded: Bounded search, not a global optimum. It compares connected routes and combinations; review the route before spending or refunding points.
treeOptimizer.skipped: Skipped plans with new unmodeled effects
treeOptimizer.needsBuild: Import or create a build to plan upgrades.
treeOptimizer.unavailable: The class start or passive graph is unavailable.
treeOptimizer.refresh: After the first search, changes refresh this open planner automatically. Cancel or collapse to pause.
treeOptimizer.waiting: Waiting for the current build calculation, then searching the updated tree…
treeOptimizer.limits: At most 8 new or refunded points and 512 full-plan evaluations per search. Refund mode moves terminal branches within the current total point count.
treeOptimizer.limited: The search limit was reached; results cover only the evaluated routes.
treeOptimizer.baselineLimitsHint: These engine-reported effects are already present in the evaluated baseline. They are not new route effects; calculated gains do not resolve these limits.
treeOptimizer.excludedHint: These evaluated edits are excluded from recommendations and cannot be applied.
